cohort: Females who had undergone a previous caesarean section, categorized into those with and without endometritis, attending the University Ultrasound clinic in Lahore.
finding: The mean thickness of C-section scars was significantly greater in women with endometritis (5.29 +/- 0.80 mm) compared to those without endometritis (2.46 +/- 0.54 mm), indicating impaired healing.
mod_finding: Endometritis significantly affected the thickness of C-section scars, demonstrating impaired healing following caesarean birth.
